PHP setcookie sends a response header, so set it before output unless buffering correctly defers output; $_COOKIE reflects received cookies. localStorage persists origin-specific string values across sessions until removed/cleared; sessionStorage is scoped to a page session/tab. Neither is automatically transmitted like matching cookies, but JavaScript can send stored data explicitly. IndexedDB supplies structured local storage. Thus all four are client storage techniques, and localStorage can participate in token-based session designs, with script-access risks. Storage size limits vary. Being logged in after reopening may use a persistent session/remember token or browser restoration; storage alone does not prove server acceptance. Web Programming module Mozilla MDN localStorage

records.title: Web Programming — Server sessions and the authorization trust path
records.text: session_start() starts/resumes PHP session handling and makes $_SESSION available. Normally the browser holds an opaque session identifier while data resides in server-controlled storage. A counter initializes missing $_SESSION["views"] to1 and increments on later requests. unset removes one entry; destroying stored session data is distinct from clearing the browser cookie/current variables, so logout must handle the full lifecycle. A client cookie logged_in=1 is attacker-controlled. If the server trusts it alone, authorization can be bypassed. If the server checks a valid session ID and its server-side user/role on every protected action, editing that unrelated flag does not grant rights. HTTPS does not make client-generated claims trustworthy. Determine which server-side check is performed before judging whether a session-handling design is secure or vulnerable. Protect session IDs, regenerate after login, expire appropriately and avoid putting sensitive tokens in URLs. Web Programming module

records.title: Web Programming — Uploads, files and storage safety
records.text: Uploads ordinarily use method="post", enctype="multipart/form-data" and a named file input. accept hints to the browser which file types to offer; it does not enforce the server’s policy. Validate server-side size/content, inspect upload errors, use the temporary upload path, choose a safe generated destination and use move_uploaded_file. Avoid executable storage and trusting a client filename/extension. file_exists tests files or directories; is_file narrows to regular files. fopen returns a stream or false: r reads an existing file, r+ reads/writes without truncation, w truncates/creates for writing, w+ adds reading, a appends/creates, and x exclusively creates. fclose releases it. readfile emits content and returns a byte count, so echo readfile(...) also prints that count. Check failures before reading/writing and constrain paths to permitted locations. Web Programming module WHATWG HTML input standard

records.title: Web Programming — Database connections, TLS and actual APIs
records.text: MySQL is a relational DBMS; a database persists structured application data and supports concurrent clients. PHP8 uses MySQLi or PDO; the old mysql_* extension was removed, so migrate older snippets to a supported API. mysqli_connect(host,user,password,database,port,socket) opens a connection; selecting a database can be deferred, and defaults make several arguments technically optional. Do not reduce the full signature to exactly one optional field. Configure MySQLi TLS options through mysqli_init(), mysqli_ssl_set(...) and mysqli_real_connect(...) with the required verification configuration. mysqli_ssl_connect(), pdo_connect_ssl(), mysql_ssl_connect() and secure_connect() are not substitutes for the MySQLi TLS configuration sequence above. PDO uses an appropriate driver DSN/options instead. MySQLi procedural functions, object methods and PDO methods have distinct signatures; affected_rows() alone is not a generic PHP function. Web Programming module PHP manual: mysqli::ssl_set PHP manual: affected_rows

records.title: Web Programming — SQL operations, result rows and safe rendering
records.text: SELECT retrieves rows; INSERT adds; UPDATE ... SET changes values; DELETE removes rows. WHERE limits affected/matching records; omitting it from DELETE ordinarily targets every row, subject to constraints, permissions and errors. CREATE DATABASE/TABLE defines storage; a primary key identifies rows. AUTO_INCREMENT generates numeric values but gaps and explicit values are possible; do not promise gapless consecutive business numbering. mysqli_query returns a result object for successful result-producing queries, true for other successful statements, or failure/exception depending on settings. Fetch associative rows with mysqli_fetch_assoc, positional rows with mysqli_fetch_row, or objects with mysqli_fetch_object. mysqli_num_rows counts a result’s rows; mysqli_affected_rows($conn) counts changed/inserted/deleted rows under its options; mysqli_insert_id($conn) reports a generated AUTO_INCREMENT value from the connection. Escape rendered cell text; use prepared statements for submitted values; mysqli_close closes the connection. Web Programming module PHP manual: affected_rows

records.title: Web Programming — PHP includes, objects and dates
records.text: include evaluates another file in the current scope and warns on failure; require fails critically. In PHP8 a failed require raises Error, which can be caught; uncaught it stops normal execution. The source’s E_COMPILE_ERROR description belongs to older PHP. include_once/require_once avoid repeated inclusion. Do not include a user-selected arbitrary path. A class defines properties/methods; new creates an object, $obj->field accesses a property, and $obj->method() calls a method. public is externally accessible, private is class-restricted, and a constructor initializes an instance. Use $this inside instance methods. DateTime/DateTimeZone represent time and zone; diff returns a DateInterval and DatePeriod iterates intervals. Time calculations require explicit zones and calendar assumptions, not an assumed server-local timezone. Web Programming module PHP manual: require

records.title: Web Programming — AJAX and response handling
records.text: AJAX means Asynchronous JavaScript and XML, but responses can be JSON, text, HTML or XML. It is a technique, not a language, standalone framework or mandatory XML protocol. Configure an XHR with open("GET",url,true), register response/error handlers and call send(). onreadystatechange may run several times; readyState4 means completion, after which status and data must be checked. A callback is a function invoked later by the runtime/API. The browser invokes its response handler when the response is available; the remote server does not directly execute browser code. With fetch, await fetch(url) obtains a response, then check response.ok and parse await response.json(). Handle network/parse errors. Starting an asynchronous operation does not make its result synchronously available to the next statement. Avoid overwriting a newer search result with an older response that arrives late. Web Programming module

records.title: Web Programming — Polling, WebSockets and data formats
records.text: Short polling repeatedly requests updates. Long polling holds one client request until an event or timeout, returns a response, then the client reconnects; it is not continuous unsolicited streaming on that same finished response. WebSocket establishes a persistent bidirectional message channel after its handshake. Either HTTP-based AJAX or WebSockets can support nonblocking user interaction and carry JSON, so generic questions may be nonexclusive. JSON represents objects, arrays, strings, numbers, Booleans and null; keys/strings use double quotes, and functions/undefined are not JSON values. XML is another valid interchange format. A REST API can return either. Select transport by latency, direction, connection cost and recovery requirements, not merely the occurrence of “asynchronous.” Validate incoming messages and enforce authorization per operation. Web Programming module

records.title: Web Programming — Node server, event loop and scaling
records.text: A minimal CommonJS Node server can use const http=require("node:http"); http.createServer((req,res)=>{res.writeHead(200,{"Content-Type":"text/plain"});res.end("Hello");}).listen(8000);. The request listener runs for incoming requests; end completes the response. Define every variable used in startup logging, including hostname, before using it. Node schedules JavaScript callbacks through an event loop and uses OS/worker facilities for asynchronous work. Concurrency means overlapping progress; parallelism means execution at the same instant. One event-loop thread can handle many waiting requests, but long CPU loops or synchronous I/O block its callbacks. Workers/processes and a load balancer distribute work across server instances; they do not automatically coordinate shared data or session state. Multiple clients, or one client with overlapping requests, can both create concurrency. Web Programming module Node.js: do not block the event loop

records.title: Web Programming — Races, locks and transaction invariants
records.text: Suppose two requests read a stock count1, both decide it is available and both write0: two sales consumed one item. Correctness depends on interleaving, even if each callback has only a short synchronous body. A mutex protects one critical section; semaphores can coordinate bounded access; spinlocks busy-wait and are unsuitable for blocking a browser/event-loop thread. Several listed mechanisms can synchronize, so mutex is not the only possible answer. In a relational database use an atomic conditional UPDATE stock SET qty=qty-1 WHERE id=? AND qty>0, check affected rows, and combine related writes in an appropriate transaction. A row lock or serializable transaction can protect multi-step logic; handle rollback/retry on conflicts. A process-local lock does not cover all load-balanced servers. Idempotency tokens with unique storage constraints prevent a retried payment from becoming a duplicate transaction. PostgreSQL transaction isolation

records.title: Web Programming — Frameworks and version-aware setup
records.text: A framework supplies conventions and reusable structure; a library supplies callable capabilities. jQuery simplifies DOM operations; React builds component interfaces; Angular is a component platform, distinct from older AngularJS; Vue also builds interactive interfaces. Each can contribute to a responsive interface, so those generic descriptions do not identify one unique framework. React props pass inputs; state records changing component data; JSX needs transformation rather than being ordinary browser JavaScript syntax. Bootstrap supplies layout/components. The jQuery→Popper→Bootstrap dependency order is version4-era guidance; Bootstrap5 drops required jQuery. Angular CLI commands include ng new, ng serve, ng build, ng generate and ng test, with e2e support depending on configuration. Use ng serve to start the development server. Create React App is deprecated; recognize it as historical tooling rather than a universal current recommendation. Web Programming module Bootstrap5 migration React installation React: passing props

records.title: Web Programming — Manage content, performance and revisions
records.text: A CMS gives editors content creation, publishing, roles and media management without editing every source file. A database stores persistent facts; it is not itself the whole server application. A VCS records source history, branches and merges to support review/collaboration; deployment publishes a chosen build and is a separate operation. SEO improves discoverability through meaningful content, headings, metadata, accessible links and crawlable structure; keyword metadata alone does not guarantee ranking. Caching reuses a representation/result and requires validity/invalidation rules. Server caching can hold rendered pages or expensive query results; never share private user content under an unsafe common key. Minification removes unnecessary source characters; bundling combines files; compression changes transfer encoding; preloading fetches anticipated resources early. Measure performance because excess preloading/bundling may compete with critical work. Responsive design and cross-browser compatibility need separate testing. Web Programming module WordPress features Google Search Central SEO Starter Guide Pro Git: About Version Control

records.title: Web Programming — Assemble and evaluate an end-to-end feature
records.text: For a course-search page, write semantic headings/navigation and a labeled search form. Use a responsive grid with a single-column fallback, then register a submit handler after parsing. Prevent default only when implementing asynchronous submission; encode search values in the query and send GET /courses?q=.... Show loading and useful error feedback without inserting untrusted HTML. The server validates query length/type, authenticates where required, runs a parameterized SELECT with a bounded result size, and returns JSON with an appropriate status/content type. The client checks status, parses data and builds nodes with textContent. For an enrollment action use POST with CSRF controls, server authorization, capacity checks and a transaction; show success only after commit. Evaluate empty/bad input, access denied, network failure, delayed responses, repeated clicks, simultaneous enrollments, narrow screens and keyboard use. This integrates all four blueprint outcomes beyond tag recall. Web Programming module

records.title: Web Programming — Validate syntax, context and output
records.text: A trace requires syntactically valid source, known initial values, execution context and output representation. x=4+"4"5 is a syntax error because an operator is missing; bool ans=true and type of new Date() are syntax errors too. PHP with >> instead of ?> may fail parsing; analyze output only after checking the closing syntax. The PHP array operator is =>; splitting it as = > is invalid syntax. Distinguish response text from browser rendering: PHP may emit markup that the browser interprets, and visual line breaks need not appear in a plain-text choice. For the assignment example above, the correct output is 60 even if it is absent from the choices. Multiple storage techniques, interface libraries, script-capable languages and cryptographic channels often satisfy broad descriptions. State the missing distinction before selecting an answer when the question admits several interpretations. With x=4+"4";, JavaScript produces 44; x=4+"4"5 is invalid because an operator is missing. The PHP string-offset example closes with ?> and prints r; using >> instead introduces a syntax error. Check the complete code and closing delimiters before tracing output. Apply each output prediction to the exact program being analyzed. Web Programming module

records.title: Web Programming — Java and JavaScript object-oriented models
records.text: Java organizes object-oriented programs using classes, objects, inheritance and interfaces. A class describes the state and behavior of its instances; inheritance relates a subclass to a superclass, and an interface specifies operations a type agrees to provide. Oracle Java Tutorials: Object-Oriented Programming Concepts

records.title: Web Programming — Form values and result destinations
records.text: For a text input, the value attribute supplies its initial text value; it does not specify the control’s width. The type attribute selects the kind of input control. A form’s target identifies the window or frame in which the submitted result is displayed. The action identifies the processing URL, so changing the destination context is different from changing the handler. In an input element, type="text" creates text entry, type="checkbox" an independently selectable checkbox, type="radio" a radio choice, and type="submit" a submit button. A hidden input carries a value without displaying an editable text field; it is not a password-masking control. HTML Standard: The input element Web Programming module · page 21

records.title: Web Programming — Message display versus response collection
records.text: alert(message), confirm(message) and prompt(message) all present a supplied message. Alert is a notification; confirm additionally asks for an OK/Cancel decision, while prompt additionally offers a text field. A general message-display description therefore differs from an information-only notification. Web Programming module · page 46 Web Programming module · page 47

records.title: Web Programming — Database API namespaces and affected rows
records.text: PDOStatement::rowCount() is a method on a PDO statement object that reports affected rows for its DELETE, INSERT or UPDATE statement. It is not a procedural MySQLi function, and its behavior for SELECT result counts is driver-dependent rather than a portable row-count guarantee. With an initialized PDO connection, $pdo->query($sql) executes an SQL statement without placeholders and returns a PDOStatement for processing its results. The connection’s configured driver determines the database; the method name alone does not mean MySQL. MySQL is an open-source SQL database management system. Its relational data-management role is distinct from the PHP API used to connect to it. The procedural MySQLi query form is mysqli_query($conn, $sql), using a MySQLi connection and the correctly spelled function name. The pg_query function belongs to PHP’s PostgreSQL extension; it is not a MySQL connection API. PHP Manual: PDOStatement::rowCount PHP Manual: PDO::query Web Programming module · page 78 PHP Manual · mysqli_query PHP Manual · pg_query

records.title: Web Programming — JavaScript execution, statement forms and error categories
records.text: JavaScript implementations may interpret or compile source; interpretation and compilation are execution strategies rather than competing language identities. An if statement conditionally executes code. The legacy with statement temporarily extends name lookup and is forbidden in strict mode. A debugger statement may invoke an active debugging facility. These are keyword-introduced statement forms, unlike the quoted use-strict directive. A syntax error prevents source from being parsed successfully. A runtime error arises while executing a program. A logical error is a defect in the algorithm or expression that can produce an incorrect result without throwing an exception. Web Programming module · page 44 ECMAScript: Statements and declarations Mozilla MDN: Troubleshooting JavaScript

records.title: Web Programming — PHP statement boundaries and string escapes
records.text: A complete ordinary PHP assignment statement ends with a semicolon. A string’s closing delimiter must match its opening delimiter; a single quote can appear inside a double-quoted string without ending it. In double-quoted PHP strings, backslash-n represents a line feed and backslash-r represents a carriage return. The written sequences are \n and \r; forward-slash sequences such as /n are ordinary text. A backslash before a dollar sign preserves that dollar sign rather than starting variable interpolation. The basic print and echo constructs can be written with or without parentheses when their syntax permits it. Parentheses do not add spaces or change the value of the emitted argument. PHP Manual: Strings Web Programming module · page 62 Web Programming module · page 63

records.title: Web Programming — Default text rendering and legacy frame fallbacks
records.text: In the browser’s default presentation, an i element typically displays its text in italics. This is a rendering convention: its text semantics are distinct from the stress emphasis represented by em, and CSS may override appearance. A legacy frameset document could include noframes content for user agents that did not support frames or were configured not to display them. Frame support was therefore not universal even in that historical model. Web Programming module · page 15 Web Programming module · page 20

records.title: Web Programming — Numeric functions and NaN checks
records.text: For finite numeric arguments, Math.abs(x) gives the nonnegative magnitude, Math.floor(x) gives the greatest integer no larger than x, and Math.sqrt(x) gives the nonnegative square root for nonnegative x. These operations differ from ordinary nearest-integer rounding; floor moves toward negative infinity. Global isNaN(value) tests whether conversion to Number produces NaN. Number.isNaN(value) tests specifically for the Number value NaN without coercion. NaN is itself a special numeric value, not a callable checking function. ECMAScript: Math object functions MDN · isNaN

records.title: Web Programming — Destroying server-side session data
records.text: session_destroy() removes the data associated with the current PHP session. It does not itself unset every current script variable or delete the browser’s session cookie; destroying stored data, clearing $_SESSION and expiring the identifier cookie are separate parts of a complete logout. Web Programming module · page 77 PHP Manual: session_destroy

records.title: Web Programming — HTTP response status classes
records.text: The first digit of an HTTP status code identifies its class: 2xx means successful handling, 3xx means redirection or further action, 4xx indicates a client-error condition, and 5xx indicates a server-error condition. Classifying a code is different from identifying the precise condition represented by its last two digits. RFC 9110: Status codes

records.title: Web Programming — Authentication versus authorization
records.text: Authentication verifies a claimed identity. Authorization checks whether a particular entity is permitted to perform a requested action. Establishing identity does not grant every permission, and neither check alone repairs unsafe SQL construction or unsafe output encoding. OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet OWASP Authorization Cheat Sheet

records.title: Web Programming — Metadata purposes
records.text: The keywords metadata name supplies terms relevant to the page, while description supplies a page summary. Robots metadata supplies crawler indexing or search-presentation instructions. These roles differ from mobile viewport control. HTML Standard: Standard metadata names Google Search Central: Robots meta tag

records.title: Web Programming — Remainder and logical conjunction
records.text: For nonnegative integers n and positive d, n % d gives the remainder after division; zero tests divisibility. With Boolean operands, && is true only when both operands are true; it is a logical operator, not a comment delimiter. Mozilla MDN: Remainder operator Mozilla MDN: Logical AND

records.title: Web Programming — Application protocols and underlying communication
records.text: HTTP defines web application requests, response status codes and representations. An HTTP exchange can use underlying TCP connections and IP addresses; naming that network stack does not identify the application-level method or status semantics. FTP is a file-transfer application protocol. SMTP transports electronic mail. These service roles differ from the HTTP resource request/response semantics used by a web browser. HTTPS adds TLS protection to HTTP rather than replacing its resource semantics. RFC 9110 · HTTP Semantics, §§3 and 4 RFC 959 · File Transfer Protocol RFC 5321 · Simple Mail Transfer Protocol

records.text: Q00018 Question 2 WEB09 WEB-S02 Which attribute of INPUT tag defines the number of characters that can be displayed in a text box without scrolling? Separate the control role, displayed content, submitted value and form destination. A SIZE B MAXLENGTH C VALUE D TYPE SIZE controls approximate visible text-input width. WEB09 distinguishes size from maxlength: size describes the approximate visible width of a text input, while maxlength limits how much text can be entered. That matches the stem’s focus on characters displayed without scrolling. VALUE provides initial content and TYPE selects the control kind; neither is the width-setting attribute requested here. A correct SIZE controls approximate visible width for a text input, matching the display-without-scrolling description. B incorrect MAXLENGTH limits entered text length rather than determining how wide the input appears. C incorrect VALUE supplies the control’s content, not its visible character-width setting. D incorrect TYPE selects the input-control kind rather than its approximate visible width.

records.text: Q00037 Question 4 WEB11 WEB07 Which statement is false about potential benefits of well-designed external style sheets? Treat benefits as possibilities, not guarantees. Identify which elements a rule targets and distinguish selector syntax from declaration syntax. A Style sheets can support accessible presentation B Style sheets can create a consistent appearance C Style sheets can make HTML pages easier to maintain D Style sheets cannot reduce repeated markup or transferred file size Style sheets cannot reduce repeated markup or transferred file size External CSS lets several pages reuse presentation rules, making visual changes easier to maintain and helping consistency. The false statement is the absolute denial of any size or transfer savings; the other choices describe potential benefits rather than universal promises. A incorrect Accessible presentation can be supported, though semantic markup and usable controls are still needed. B incorrect Reused rules can give pages a consistent appearance. C incorrect Central rules reduce repeated presentation edits across pages. D correct This absolute denial is false: reuse and caching can reduce repeated markup and transfers.

records.text: Q00062 Question 5 WEB-S08 What will be the out of the following JavaScript statement? Math.abs(-9) Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A 9 B -9 C 1 D 0 9 WEB18 explicitly evaluates Math.abs(-9) as 9. Absolute value removes the negative sign from a negative numeric argument and leaves its magnitude, so the result is neither the original negative number nor a Boolean-like one or zero. This is an expression result; no rounding or text conversion is involved. A correct The absolute value of negative nine is its nonnegative magnitude, nine. B incorrect Negative nine is the input; absolute value does not preserve its negative sign. C incorrect Math.abs returns numeric magnitude rather than a Boolean-like value of one. D incorrect The input is nonzero, so its absolute value is not zero.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 8 · Q00075
records.text: Q00075 Question 8 WEB01 WEB15 Which statement is false about modern JavaScript running in a browser sandbox? Check exact language syntax, declaration rules and execution context before reasoning about the result. A The language cannot support sophisticated applications B Scripts can access selected client devices through permission-based APIs C Scripts have restricted access to arbitrary client files and hardware D Script source can be supplied as text and executed by the browser The language cannot support sophisticated applications Browser JavaScript supports sophisticated applications; its sandbox is a restriction on access to resources, not proof of an inherently weak language. Selected file or device access can be exposed through permission-based APIs, while arbitrary hardware access remains restricted. JavaScript source can be included in pages or loaded from a script file. Thus the language-capability claim is false, while the qualified environment and source-delivery claims are compatible. A correct The note explicitly allows sophisticated applications, so this denial is false. B incorrect Permission-based APIs allow selected device access. C incorrect Sandbox restrictions limit arbitrary resource access. D incorrect Script inclusion supplies source for browser execution.

records.text: Q00980 Question 44 WEB29 A developer stores $_SESSION["user_id"] server-side and an editable logged_in cookie client-side. records.title: Web Programming — Question 62 · Q01081
records.text: Q01081 Question 62 WEB19 Which option names the three clauses of the general JavaScript for-loop form, regardless of how the loop variable changes? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A the initialization, the Incrementation, and update B the initialization, the test, and the update C the initialization, the test, and Incrementation D All of the above the initialization, the test, and the update The general form is for(initialization; test; update). Initialization runs once, the test decides whether another iteration starts, and the update follows each completed body. An update can increment, decrement or perform another expression. Therefore an increment-only description is narrower than the general clause name. The first alternative also omits the test, so the aggregate alternative is incorrect. A incorrect Incrementation and update overlap, and the condition/test clause is missing. B correct These are the three general clause names, independent of the particular update expression. C incorrect Incrementing is one possible update; it is not the general name for a clause that may instead decrement or do something else. D incorrect The first alternative omits the test, and the increment-only alternative is not the general form.

They differ in when and how failure appears: parsing may prevent execution, runtime errors occur during execution, and logical errors can produce incorrect results without throwing. B incorrect Thrown execution errors are runtime errors, but they are only one of the listed categories. records.title: Web Programming — Question 76 · Q01096
records.text: Q01096 Question 76 WEB17 What does this JavaScript output? var a = "20"; var b = a = 30; document.write(a + b); Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. records.title: Web Programming — Question 77 · Q01097
records.text: Q01097 Question 77 WEB16 What is divide by 0 in JavaScript? var a = 10;var b = 0;document.write(a/b); Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A Nothing is printed B 0 is printed C Infinity is printed D Some Garbage Value Infinity is printed. WEB16 states that a nonzero Number divided by zero produces signed Infinity. records.title: Web Programming — Question 78 · Q01098
records.text: Q01098 Question 78 WEB18 Which of the following function of Array object applies a function simultaneously against two values of the array (from right-to-left) as to reduce it to a single value? Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. D uniquely matches the intended directional reduction. A incorrect pop removes the last item and does not repeatedly combine items into an accumulated result. B incorrect reduce combines left to right, contrary to the direction specified in the question. C incorrect push appends items at the array end rather than reducing existing items to one accumulated value. D correct reduceRight performs the requested right-to-left reduction, but sequentially rather than literally simultaneously.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 79 · Q01099
records.text: Q01099 Question 79 WEB16 What is the output of following Javascript?var a = 'letsfind';var b = 'course';var c = a/b;document.write(c); Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A letsfindcourse B letsfind/course C NaN D None of the above NaN WEB16 says arithmetic division converts ordinary numeric strings and gives NaN when nonnumeric strings are divided. A incorrect Concatenation would use + with strings; the source instead applies arithmetic division. B incorrect The slash is an operator, not a literal character appended between the two strings. records.title: Web Programming — Question 80 · Q01100
records.text: Q01100 Question 80 WEB17 What does the following JavaScript code write? var a = 1; document.write(a--); document.write(a); Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A 00 B 01 C 11 D 10 10 The source uses a-- despite the introductory mention of ++. Starting with a=1, postfix decrement yields the old value 1 to the first write and then changes a to 0. The second write outputs 0. No separator is written between calls, so the displayed result is 10, exactly as WEB17 explains. A incorrect Postfix decrement yields the original one for the first write, so the first digit cannot be zero. B incorrect This reverses the old-value and updated-value order of the two writes. C incorrect The decrement changes a to zero before the second write, so the second digit is not one. D correct The first write gets old value one, then the second gets updated zero, yielding adjacent text 10.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 81 · Q01101
records.text: Q01101 Question 81 WEB17 Find output of below JavaScript addition codedocument.write("1 plus 1 is " + 1 + 1); Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A 2 B 1 plus 1 is 2 C 1 plus 1 is 11 D 1 plus 1 is 1 + 1 1 plus 1 is 11 WEB17 explicitly traces this expression. Starting with a string makes the first + concatenate the first numeric 1, producing a longer string. The next + then concatenates the second 1 rather than adding numbers. The original literal supplies the words and spaces, while the two appended digits have no extra separator. The result is 1 plus 1 is 11. A incorrect The initial string is retained, and the two numbers are not added together first. B incorrect This would require grouping the numeric addition before concatenating it with the initial string. C correct Left-to-right evaluation concatenates each one to the existing string, producing the final digits 11. D incorrect The plus signs are operators rather than literal characters in the output string.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 83 · Q01103
records.text: Q01103 Question 83 WEB19 Does JavaScript allow exception handling? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A Yes, it provides try, catch as well as throw key word for exception handling B Yes, but it provides only try block C Yes, but it provides only Try catch block, but does not allow throw exception D No Yes: try, catch, and throw are supported. WEB19 explicitly states that try/catch handles thrown errors during execution and throw signals an error. Thus A includes both handling and signaling mechanisms. The alternatives claiming only try, denying throw, or denying exception handling contradict that rule. This concerns runtime exception handling; it does not imply that every parse-time or logical error is caught automatically. A correct JavaScript provides try/catch to handle thrown errors and throw to signal them, as WEB19 states. B incorrect The language provides catch and throw as well as try, so this restriction is false. C incorrect WEB19 explicitly includes throw; the language does not prohibit explicitly signaling an exception. D incorrect JavaScript does support exception handling through the mechanisms described in the complete note.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 84 · Q01104
records.text: Q01104 Question 84 WEB-S08 Which of the following method checks if its argument is not a number? Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A isNaN() B nonNaN() C NaN() D None of the above isNaN(), with coercion caveats. WEB16 distinguishes global isNaN, which converts its argument first, from Number.isNaN, which does not. Of the offered names, isNaN is the actual check for a NaN result after coercion. It is not a universal test for whether the original argument’s type is Number. Neither nonNaN nor calling NaN as a function supplies the described API. A correct Global isNaN exists and tests for NaN after numeric conversion; it is not a pure original-type test. B incorrect nonNaN() is not the check named in the supplied JavaScript API rule. C incorrect NaN is the special numeric value, not the callable checking function offered here. D incorrect isNaN is offered and matches the intended check, subject to the note’s coercion caveat.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 88 · Q01108
records.text: Q01108 Question 88 WEB21 An inline onkeydown handler returns false for a cancelable keydown event whose default action is text insertion. Which statement correctly describes the cancellation? Separate event dispatch, handler registration and cancellation of the browser default action. A The default text-insertion action associated with the handled keydown is canceled B A later keypress handler retroactively cancels the earlier keydown event C The keyup event is necessarily prevented from being dispatched D Every later keyboard event is necessarily canceled The default text-insertion action associated with the handled keydown is canceled An appropriate inline event handler can use a false return value to cancel the handled event’s default action. With the cancelable text-insertion action specified here, that default action is stopped. This does not erase an earlier event or guarantee that later keyboard events disappear. The distinction is between canceling a default behavior and suppressing an entire sequence of event dispatches; addEventListener would require preventDefault instead. A correct The inline handler convention consumes false to cancel the specified default action. B incorrect A later handler cannot undo the dispatch of an earlier event. C incorrect Canceling a default action does not guarantee suppression of keyup dispatch. D incorrect The cancellation concerns the handled default action, not every later event.

records.text: Q01200 Question 124 WEB31 WEB-S04 Using PHP8 standard database extensions, which snippet can issue the shown SELECT against MySQL? A incorrect mysql_query belongs to the removed mysql_* extension and is not a PHP8 standard MySQL call. records.title: Web Programming — Question 128 · Q01235
records.text: Q01235 Question 128 WEB26 WEB33 Which PHP mechanisms can participate in generating dynamic content and server-side processing? Select all that apply. Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A Functions B Variables C Classes D Objects Functions; Variables; Classes; Objects Dynamic PHP responses can combine values, reusable behavior and object-based structures. Variables hold incoming or computed data; functions carry out processing; classes define application state and behavior; objects are instances used by that logic. None of these mechanisms alone defines dynamic PHP, but each can participate in it. The revised wording therefore asks for all contributors rather than forcing one exclusive mechanism from four compatible choices. A correct Functions can process inputs and return values or produce output. B correct Variables hold request data and computed values used in a response. C correct Classes define state and behavior for server application logic. D correct Objects instantiate classes and can participate in generating responses.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 130 · Q01239
records.text: Q01239 Question 130 WEB14 Which snippet applies a one-column card layout only when the viewport is at most 600 CSS pixels wide? Identify the requested presentation effect and layout context before matching the property or rule. A plain flex declaration does not express this breakpoint or column requirement. Rotation and background color affect appearance without implementing the requested conditional layout. A correct The media condition and one-track declaration implement the stated breakpoint behavior. B incorrect This does not specify the requested viewport condition or card-grid track count. C incorrect Rotation does not create the conditional one-column layout. D incorrect A background color does not alter the grid at the required breakpoint.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 131 · Q01244
records.text: Q01244 Question 131 WEB29 WEB28 Which of the following is used to store user data on the server-side in web applications? Follow the identifier and server-side state through the stated lifecycle or access check; distinguish client-controlled claims from server decisions. A Cookies B Sessions C Local storage D IndexedDB Sessions In conventional server-backed sessions, the browser normally keeps an opaque identifier and the user’s session data resides in server-controlled storage. Cookies, localStorage and IndexedDB instead retain data on the client side. Client storage may participate in an application design, but it is not the server-side session-data store requested. Sessions therefore match the stated location. A incorrect Cookies hold browser-side values; a session cookie normally carries an identifier rather than the server’s session-data store. B correct A server-backed session keeps the user’s session data in server-controlled storage. C incorrect localStorage retains origin-specific strings in browser storage rather than storing the server’s session data. D incorrect IndexedDB is structured local browser storage rather than the server’s session-data store.

records.text: Q01611 Question 137 WEB19 WEB-S05 WEB17 Which of the following is the correct output for the following JavaScript code: function check(option) { return(option ? "true" : "false"); } bool ans=true; console.log(check(ans)); Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. records.text: SM0080 Question 147 WEB10 WEB-S07 Which one of the following is true about frames in HTML? Use the element or attribute meaning and document structure, rather than appearance or a similar-looking name. A Every frame must display the same HTML document B A legacy frameset document uses body in place of frameset C All browsers support frames D Frames allow parts of the page to remain stationary while other parts scroll Frames allow parts of the page to remain stationary while other parts scroll A legacy frameset divides a window into separate documents, and individual frame views can scroll independently. records.title: Web Programming — Question 148 · SM0085
records.text: SM0085 Question 148 WEB-S08 What will be the output of the following JavaScript statement? Math.floor(5.9) Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A 9 B 11.8 C 6 D 5 5 WEB18 directly evaluates Math.floor(5.9)=5. The floor operation gives the greatest integer not exceeding the input, rather than rounding to the nearest integer or multiplying the input. Thus the fractional part does not push the result up to six; the expression value is five. No string or DOM behavior changes this math result. A incorrect Nine is not the integer floor of 5.9; it is merely a digit appearing in the input. B incorrect 11.8 doubles the input and is unrelated to the floor operation. C incorrect Six would be upward or nearest-integer rounding here, not floor. D correct Five is the greatest integer no larger than 5.9, matching the explicit note example.

Six squared gives thirty-six, and this function returns the nonnegative square root rather than the original operand or an arithmetic difference. The expression is already a valid numeric function call and needs no parsing repair or context-dependent type coercion to obtain the stated result. A correct Six is the nonnegative square root of thirty-six, exactly as WEB18 evaluates it. B incorrect Thirty is not a square root of thirty-six and does not match the defined function. C incorrect One squared is one, not thirty-six, so it cannot be the result. D incorrect Thirty-six is the input; sqrt does not simply return it unchanged.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 157 · SS101
records.text: SS101 Question 157 WEB03 Which option identifies components present in an HTTP/1.1 request even when it has no message body?
