records.title: Web Programming — Question 160 · Q01135_LOCAL69
records.text: Q01135_LOCAL69 Question 160 WEB25 A variable declared _____ has a LOCAL SCOPE? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A outside program B inside function C outside function D None of the Above Inside a function WEB25 states that a function’s locals and by-value parameters are separate bindings from variables outside it. Thus a variable declared inside a function has ordinary local scope, unless a special explicit global binding is introduced. Outside function is the global-scope location, while outside program is not a meaningful declaration location in the script. A incorrect Outside program does not describe a declaration location within the executing PHP script. B correct An ordinary declaration inside a function creates a local binding for that function. C incorrect Variables declared outside functions have global scope under WEB25. D incorrect Inside function is offered and matches the ordinary local-binding rule.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 161 · AM0051
records.text: AM0051 Question 161 WEB01 What is the primary markup language used for structuring content on the web? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP HTML HTML is explicitly a markup language telling browsers how to structure pages, while CSS handles appearance and JavaScript behavior. Evidence: PDF p. 10, PDF p. 60. A correct Exact markup/structure role. B incorrect Stylesheet/presentation role. C incorrect Programming/behavior role. D incorrect Server-side scripting role.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 162 · AM0052
records.text: AM0052 Question 162 WEB01 What is the purpose of CSS in web development? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A To define the semantic document structure using HTML elements B To add interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages C To control the visual appearance of web pages D To handle server-side processing and database interactions To control the visual appearance of web pages CSS controls visual presentation, including colors, typography and layout. HTML supplies document structure and meaning; JavaScript supplies programmable browser interaction. Server technologies such as PHP generate responses and interact with databases. With the structural distractor confined to semantic elements, the presentation alternative is the unique description of CSS’s role. A incorrect Semantic document elements and structure are HTML’s role rather than CSS’s presentation role. B incorrect Programmable interaction is the JavaScript role, distinct from CSS styling. C correct Visual presentation is the central CSS role. D incorrect Server processing and database access belong to server application code.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 163 · AM0053
records.text: AM0053 Question 163 WEB01 Which programming language is primarily used for client-side scripting in web development? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP JavaScript The client-side scripting chapter identifies JavaScript as the language adding browser behavior; HTML structures, CSS presents, PHP executes server-side. Evidence: PDF p. 44, PDF p. 60. A incorrect Markup structure, not the scripting language. B incorrect Stylesheet presentation, not scripting. C correct Exact browser scripting language. D incorrect Server-side language in p.60.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 164 · AM0054
records.text: AM0054 Question 164 WEB01 WEB-S14 Which application-layer protocol defines the requests and responses used to retrieve web resources? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A HTTP B FTP C TCP/IP D SMTP HTTP HTTP defines the application-level exchange for web resource requests and responses. TCP/IP supplies underlying communication facilities, so naming the application layer distinguishes the required role. FTP and SMTP concern other application services rather than the web resource exchange described. HTTPS adds TLS protection to HTTP; the question asks for the underlying web application protocol. A correct HTTP defines the web resource request/response exchange. B incorrect FTP is a file-transfer protocol, not the application protocol defining the stated web resource exchange. C incorrect TCP/IP names underlying network/transport facilities, not this application-layer request/response protocol. D incorrect SMTP concerns mail transfer rather than the web resource request/response exchange.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 165 · AM0055
records.text: AM0055 Question 165 WEB01 What is the purpose of a web server in web development? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A To store and manage website files B To handle client-side scripting C To control the visual appearance of web pages D To ensure secure data transmission over the web To store and manage website files Web servers store the files comprising websites and deliver pages to requesting browsers (p.9). Client interactivity and visual styling have separate JavaScript/CSS roles. Evidence: PDF p. 9, PDF p. 44. A correct Direct storage/hosting role. B incorrect Client-side behavior is assigned to JavaScript. C incorrect Presentation is assigned to CSS. D incorrect Secure transport is not the general server definition supplied.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 166 · AM0056
records.text: AM0056 Question 166 WEB-S04 WEB31 Which listed DBMS is the open-source relational SQL server used by the course’s PHP database examples, including its MySQLi connection and query operations? Identify the API and operation first, then distinguish connection setup, statement execution and result processing. A MySQL B Oracle C SQL Server D MongoDB MySQL The note identifies MySQL as an open-source SQL DBMS and uses it as the database server for the PHP MySQLi examples. The question asks for that specific course example, so MySQL is the matching system. Oracle, SQL Server and MongoDB are different named systems; this selection does not depend on an unsupported popularity ranking or a claim that no other database has open-source editions. A correct MySQL is the open-source SQL DBMS used as the server in the course’s MySQLi examples. B incorrect Oracle is a different named database system, not the MySQL server used by these examples. C incorrect SQL Server is a different named database system from the server used by the course’s MySQLi examples. D incorrect MongoDB is not the named SQL server used by the course’s MySQLi examples.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 167 · AM0057
records.text: AM0057 Question 167 WEB28 WEB29 what is the purpose of a cookie in web development? Follow the identifier and server-side state through the stated lifecycle or access check; distinguish client-controlled claims from server decisions. A To store and retrieve user preferences and session information B To control the visual appearance of web pages C To handle client-side scripting D To ensure secure data transmission over the web To store and retrieve user preferences and session information Cookies remember user information across requests and are stored as name/value pairs (p.58). A matches retaining preferences/session information rather than styling, executing scripts or guaranteeing transport security. Evidence: PDF p. 58, PDF p. 59. A correct Matches remembering user information. B incorrect Presentation is CSS, not cookie storage. C incorrect Cookies store data, not the client scripting language itself. D incorrect The cookie definition supplies no secure-transport guarantee.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 168 · AM0058
records.text: AM0058 Question 168 WEB01 Which listed programming languages can execute server-side web application code? Select all that apply. Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP JavaScript; PHP PHP is a server-response language, and JavaScript can execute on the server through runtimes such as Node.js. JavaScript is therefore not excluded merely because it also runs in browsers. HTML supplies document structure and CSS supplies presentation rules rather than the requested server application scripting role. Both supported programming-language choices must be selected under the revised multiple-selection wording. A incorrect HTML supplies document structure and meaning rather than server application scripting. B incorrect CSS supplies presentation rules rather than server application scripting. C correct JavaScript can run server-side, including through Node.js. D correct PHP can generate server responses and access application data.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 169 · AM0059
records.text: AM0059 Question 169 WEB38 What is the purpose of a framework in web development? Match the stated application requirement to the capabilities and category of each technology. A To ensure secure data transmission over the web B To control the visual appearance of web pages C To provide a foundation and structure for developing web applications D To handle client-side scripting To provide a foundation and structure for developing web applications The framework chapter describes integrated components, libraries and developer tools for building applications. This provides the reusable foundation in C; particular frameworks may also style or script pages, but those are narrower uses. Evidence: PDF p. 93, PDF p. 91. A incorrect Secure transport is not the general framework purpose given. B incorrect Styling is a subset of Bootstrap functionality, not the general foundation role. C correct Matches integrated application-building structure/tools. D incorrect Client scripting is only one part of the framework examples.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 170 · AM0060
records.text: AM0060 Question 170 WEB01 WEB36 Which programming language is often used for building scalable and high-performance web applications? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D Node.js JavaScript is the language; Node.js is a runtime. WEB01 explicitly distinguishes Node.js from the language it runs. JavaScript is therefore the offered programming-language answer for Node-based server applications. HTML and CSS supply structure and presentation. Scalability and performance depend on workload and architecture, as WEB36 explains, so the answer identifies the language without promising that its use alone guarantees high performance. A incorrect HTML is structural markup rather than the server application language requested. B incorrect CSS supplies presentation rather than programmable server application logic. C correct JavaScript is the programming language used by Node applications. D incorrect Node.js is a JavaScript runtime, not a separate programming language.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 171 · AM0061
records.text: AM0061 Question 171 WEB34 What is the purpose of AJAX in web development? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A To control the visual appearance of web pages B To handle client-side scripting C To ensure secure data transmission over the web D To enable asynchronous communication between the client and server To enable asynchronous communication between the client and server AJAX asynchronously communicates with the server, exchanges data and updates pages without refresh (p.89). D is the precise purpose; client-side scripting is the broader environment, not the distinguishing function. Evidence: PDF p. 89. A incorrect Visual styling is a cooperating CSS role. B incorrect Broad surrounding activity, not the specific AJAX purpose. C incorrect No secure-transport guarantee is given. D correct Exact asynchronous client/server exchange purpose.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 172 · AM0062
records.text: AM0062 Question 172 WEB35 WEB01 Which listed formats can represent structured application data for server/browser interchange, rather than document presentation or styling? Select all that apply. Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A HTML B CSS C JSON D XML JSON; XML JSON represents structured values such as objects and arrays, while XML is another supported interchange format. A REST API may return either, so data interchange alone does not choose one uniquely. HTML can be delivered as a response document, but the revised question distinguishes that presentation role from the structured-data formats sought here. CSS expresses styling rules. JSON and XML therefore form the requested selection. A incorrect HTML’s role here is the response document, not the requested structured-data interchange format. B incorrect CSS expresses presentation rules rather than application-data interchange. C correct JSON represents structured data values for interchange. D correct XML is another valid structured-data interchange format.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 173 · AM0063
records.text: AM0063 Question 173 WEB39 WEB01 What is the purpose of a content management system (CMS) in web development? Distinguish the purpose of each development or performance technique from its possible side effects. A To store and manage website files B To control the visual appearance of web pages C To handle client-side scripting D To provide a user-friendly interface for managing website content An editor-facing interface for managing website content. A CMS gives editors content creation, publishing, roles, and media management without editing every source file. That directly matches D’s user-facing content-management interface. File storage may support it but is not its complete purpose; CSS controls appearance and JavaScript supplies client scripting. The requested role is editorial content management. A incorrect File storage can support a CMS, but does not capture its editor-facing content creation and publishing purpose. B incorrect Visual presentation is primarily CSS’s role, not the defining purpose of a CMS. C incorrect Client-side scripting is a JavaScript role rather than the CMS’s defining editorial function. D correct A CMS provides editors an interface and workflow for creating, publishing, and managing site content.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 174 · AM0064
records.text: AM0064 Question 174 WEB39 Which technique is used to improve the performance of web applications by caching frequently accessed data or resources? Distinguish the purpose of each development or performance technique from its possible side effects. A Compression B Minification C Caching D Encryption Caching WEB39 defines caching as reusing a representation or result and requiring validity or invalidation rules. Keeping frequently accessed data for reuse is therefore Caching. Compression and minification reduce transfer or source size, while encryption protects data; none of those alone stores a reusable computed result. Cache keys and privacy still matter when using the technique safely. A incorrect Compression changes transfer encoding or size rather than retaining a result for repeated reuse. B incorrect Minification removes unnecessary source characters and does not itself store frequently reused results. C correct Caching retains a representation or result so later accesses can reuse it without repeating all prior work. D incorrect Encryption protects data confidentiality rather than supplying the result-reuse technique described.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 175 · AM0065
records.text: AM0065 Question 175 WEB05 WEB-S14 Which protocol is used for secure communication over the web? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. A HTTP B FTP C TCP/IP D HTTPS HTTPS WEB05 defines HTTPS as HTTP over TLS, protecting channel confidentiality and integrity and authenticating the server through certificate checks. That is the secure web-communication protocol among the main choices. Plain HTTP, FTP, and TCP/IP do not by their names supply that TLS-protected web exchange. The alternate option set places HTTPS at C, so its answer letter differs. A incorrect Plain HTTP does not by itself add TLS confidentiality, integrity, and certificate-based server authentication. B incorrect FTP is not the HTTPS protocol for TLS-protected web communication identified in the note. C incorrect TCP/IP names underlying networking protocols rather than the TLS-protected HTTP scheme requested. D correct HTTPS is HTTP over TLS and supplies the channel protections described in WEB05.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 176 · AM0066
records.text: AM0066 Question 176 WEB05 What is the purpose of a RESTful API in web development? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. A To control the visual appearance of web pages B To handle client-side scripting C To ensure secure data transmission over the web D To provide a standardized interface for accessing and manipulating web resources A uniform interface for accessing and manipulating resources. WEB05 describes REST constraints including client/server separation, stateless requests, and a uniform resource interface. It associates identified resources with representations and methods for reading or changing them. D expresses that purpose. CSS handles appearance, JavaScript supplies client interactivity, and HTTPS supplies channel protection; none of those is the defining role of REST itself. A incorrect Visual presentation is a CSS role, not the defining purpose of a REST resource interface. B incorrect Client-side scripting is a JavaScript role rather than the definition of REST architecture. C incorrect TLS/HTTPS protects transmission; a REST interface does not itself guarantee secure transport. D correct REST supplies a uniform resource interface for accessing representations and requesting resource operations.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 177 · AM0067
records.text: AM0067 Question 177 WEB14 WEB06 What is the purpose of responsive web design? Identify the requested presentation effect and layout context before matching the property or rule. A To control the visual appearance of web pages B To handle client-side scripting C To ensure secure data transmission over the web D To create websites that adapt and display correctly on different devices and screen sizes To create websites that adapt and display correctly on different devices and screen sizes The framework chapter requires support for desktop, tablet and phone screen sizes and describes responsive mobile-first websites. D directly captures this adaptation goal. Evidence: PDF p. 91. A incorrect General styling alone does not specify adaptation. B incorrect Scripting alone does not specify adaptation. C incorrect Transport security is unrelated to the described screen-size goal. D correct Exact device/screen adaptation purpose.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 178 · AM0068
records.text: AM0068 Question 178 WEB39 What is the purpose of version control systems (VCS) in web development? Distinguish the purpose of each development or performance technique from its possible side effects. A To control the visual appearance of web pages B To handle client-side scripting C To ensure secure data transmission over the web D To track changes to source code and collaborate on web development projects Track source changes and support collaboration. WEB39 defines VCS through recording source history, branches, and merges for review and collaboration. That directly matches D. Styling and client-side scripting are product technologies, while transport security is an HTTPS concern. A VCS can help teams review changes, but publishing a chosen build is a separate deployment action rather than its definition. A incorrect VCS records source history; CSS rather than version control determines rendered appearance. B incorrect Version control tracks scripts as files but does not execute client-side scripting. C incorrect Version history and collaboration do not themselves provide secure web transport. D correct Source history, branching, merging, and review support tracking changes and collaborating on development.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 179 · AM0069
records.text: AM0069 Question 179 WEB39 Which web development concept refers to the practice of optimizing a website to rank higher in search engine results? Distinguish the purpose of each development or performance technique from its possible side effects. A Accessibility B Usability C SEO (Search Engine Optimization) D Performance optimization SEO: Search Engine Optimization WEB39 describes SEO as improving discoverability through meaningful content, headings, metadata, links, and crawlable structure. That matches the practice of improving search-result visibility. Accessibility, usability, and performance can overlap with helpful site improvements, but none is the name of this search-discoverability objective. Ranking improvement is an aim, not a guarantee from a single metadata setting. A incorrect Accessibility concerns usable access to content and controls, rather than naming the search-ranking optimization practice. B incorrect Usability concerns user experience and task completion, not specifically search-engine discoverability. C correct Search Engine Optimization names the practice of improving discoverability in search results. D incorrect Performance optimization improves resource delivery or execution speed, not the specific search-ranking practice named here.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 180 · AM0070
records.text: AM0070 Question 180 WEB27 WEB-S11 Which activity is specifically used to detect XSS and SQL-injection weaknesses so they can then be repaired? Identify the data source or security responsibility precisely, and check whether a combined source or a different control could also qualify. A Encryption B Authentication C Authorization D Web application security testing Web application security testing Web application security testing can detect SQL injection and XSS and provide evidence for repairs. Detection does not by itself remove the flaws: safe query parameterization and context-appropriate output handling are still required. Encryption, authentication and authorization address other protection goals and do not perform the vulnerability-testing activity requested. Changing the stem from a claim of prevention to a detection task preserves the security-testing concept without overstating its effect. A incorrect Encryption protects content but is not the requested detection activity. B incorrect Authentication checks identity rather than testing for these code weaknesses. C incorrect Authorization checks permitted actions rather than conducting vulnerability tests. D correct This is the testing activity used to discover the specified weaknesses.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 181 · AM0071
records.text: AM0071 Question 181 WEB23 WEB24 A server request handler contains this fragment, with no user-defined syntax extensions: $visitor = "Mimi"; echo "Hello, " . $visitor; Which listed language accepts this fragment as written in its normal language environment? Trace the bindings and operations in order; preserve the exact string characters and distinguish returned values from emitted output. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP PHP The fragment uses a dollar-prefixed variable, the echo output construct and dot concatenation. Together these are valid PHP syntax, producing the greeting by joining two strings. JavaScript uses different output calls and does not use dot as this binary concatenation operator. HTML and CSS provide structure and presentation rather than directly executing this server-side statement sequence. Recognizing the actual syntax resolves the language choice without excluding JavaScript from server programming generally. A incorrect HTML markup does not execute this variable assignment and output-construct sequence. B incorrect CSS presentation rules do not execute this statement sequence. C incorrect The echo construct and dot concatenation shown are not ordinary JavaScript syntax. D correct PHP accepts the assignment, echo construct and dot concatenation as written.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 182 · AM0072
records.text: AM0072 Question 182 WEB01 WEB36 Which server-side scripting language is often used for building scalable and high- performance web applications? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D Node.js JavaScript, executed server-side by runtimes such as Node.js. WEB01 directly distinguishes JavaScript as a language and Node.js as its runtime. The question asks for the language, so C is the category-correct option. WEB36 warns that long CPU work or synchronous I/O can block Node callbacks, so scalability is architectural and workload-dependent rather than a guarantee from the language name alone. A incorrect HTML is markup for structure rather than server-side application scripting. B incorrect CSS is presentation rather than the server application language requested. C correct JavaScript is the language that runs in Node-based server applications. D incorrect Node.js is a runtime, not a distinct server-side scripting language.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 183 · AM0073
records.text: AM0073 Question 183 WEB01 What is the purpose of server-side scripting languages in web development? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A To control the visual appearance of web pages B To handle client-side interactivity C To generate dynamic content and interact with databases D To ensure secure data transmission over the web To generate dynamic content and interact with databases Server PHP generates dynamic output and connects sites to backend databases, enabling two-way communication (p.60). C combines those explicitly described purposes. Evidence: PDF p. 60, PDF p. 44. A incorrect CSS presentation role. B incorrect Client JavaScript role. C correct Exact dynamic-output/database role. D incorrect Transport security is not the stated server scripting purpose.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 184 · AM0074
records.text: AM0074 Question 184 WEB01 Which of the following is a server-side scripting language for Microsoft's ASP.NET framework? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A Python B Ruby C C# D Java C# WEB01 explicitly states that C# is commonly used with ASP.NET. That identifies the requested language among the main options. Python and Java can be used for server applications in other roles described here, but are not its stated ASP.NET pairing. The answer concerns language/framework association, not a claim that only one language can ever interact with the platform. A incorrect Python is a server-side language, but it is not the ASP.NET language pairing identified in WEB01. B incorrect Ruby is not the language explicitly paired with ASP.NET in the supplied note. C correct WEB01 explicitly states that C# is commonly used with ASP.NET. D incorrect The note associates Java with JSP/Java server applications, while identifying C# for ASP.NET.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 185 · AM0075
records.text: AM0075 Question 185 WEB01 Which client-side scripting language is supported by all modern web browsers? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP JavaScript The JavaScript chapter describes browser functionality and modern browser JavaScript interactivity. C matches the client scripting language; HTML and CSS have different structural/presentation roles and PHP is server-side. Evidence: PDF p. 44, PDF p. 56, PDF p. 60. A incorrect Markup language, not scripting. B incorrect Stylesheet language, not scripting. C correct Browser scripting language described throughout chapter 4. D incorrect Explicit server-side language.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 186 · AM0076
records.text: AM0076 Question 186 WEB01 What is the purpose of client-side scripting languages in web development? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A To control the visual appearance of web pages B To handle server-side processing and database interactions C To generate dynamic content and interact with databases D To add interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages To add interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages JavaScript implements timely updates, interactive maps and animated graphics (p.44). This is the client-side interactivity/dynamic-behavior purpose in D. Evidence: PDF p. 44, PDF p. 60. A incorrect CSS presentation is a different layer. B incorrect Server/database processing belongs to server scripting. C incorrect Server-generated database output is a different role. D correct Matches interactive client behavior.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 187 · AM0077
records.text: AM0077 Question 187 WEB01 WEB20 Which client-side scripting language is primarily used for manipulating the Document Object Model (DOM) of a web page? Track which node is selected or created, and distinguish changing content from attaching a node. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP JavaScript The module JavaScript DOM section explains accessing elements and changing document structure, style and content. That makes JavaScript the client scripting language for DOM manipulation. Evidence: PDF p. 52, PDF p. 60. A incorrect HTML supplies structure rather than the client scripting operation. B incorrect CSS styles content rather than being the scripting language. C correct Explicitly uses DOM APIs to access/change pages. D incorrect PHP executes on the server in this module.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 188 · AM0078
records.text: AM0078 Question 188 WEB01 WEB21 Which client-side scripting language is often used for validating form inputs on web pages? Separate event dispatch, handler registration and cancellation of the browser default action. A HTML B CSS C JavaScript D PHP JavaScript The module includes a JavaScript form-validation example checking an empty field and prompting the user. C identifies the scripting language performing that check. Evidence: PDF p. 55, PDF p. 73. A incorrect HTML can provide basic validation but is not the requested scripting language. B incorrect Presentation language, not this validation script. C correct Exact language of the documented validation example. D incorrect PHP validates on the server, not in the browser.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 189 · AM0079
records.text: AM0079 Question 189 WEB34 WEB38 WEB35 Which client-side scripting technique allows for loading new content into a web page without a full page reload? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A AJAX B JSON C XML D Bootstrap AJAX AJAX explicitly requests data and updates a page without full refresh. JSON/XML are possible exchange formats, and Bootstrap is a responsive UI framework. Evidence: PDF p. 89, PDF p. 91. A correct Exact no-refresh exchange technique. B incorrect A supported data format, not the exchange technique. C incorrect Another data format, not the technique. D incorrect Responsive framework, not the AJAX request mechanism.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 190 · AM0080
records.text: AM0080 Question 190 WEB38 A course-catalog page already has CSS that switches between one and three columns at the required viewport widths. It still needs a browser-side filter that updates the visible course cards without a full-page reload. With suitable application code, which listed technologies can implement that interaction while retaining the CSS layout? Select all that apply. Match the stated application requirement to the capabilities and category of each technology. A jQuery B React C Angular D Vue.js jQuery; React; Angular; Vue.js The responsive layout is already supplied by CSS; the remaining task is programmable interface behavior. jQuery can update the DOM, and React, Angular and Vue can implement the filter and visible-card updates through their interface facilities. None is uniquely required by this interaction. All four remain possible choices when suitable application code is supplied, without implying that selecting any toolkit automatically implements responsiveness or the filter itself. A correct jQuery can handle filter interaction and update existing DOM content while the CSS controls layout. B correct React can render the filtered card interface while using the supplied responsive CSS. C correct Angular can implement the filter interaction and visible-card updates with the existing layout styles. D correct Vue can update visible cards in response to filter input while retaining responsive styles.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 191 · AM0081
records.text: AM0081 Question 191 WEB34 WEB35 WEB05 A page sends asynchronous HTTP requests and uses each response to update part of the page without a full navigation. Which listed technique names this browser request-and-update pattern? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A AJAX B JSON C Websockets D RESTful API AJAX AJAX is the technique of using asynchronous browser HTTP requests to obtain data and update part of a page. It can carry JSON, XML or other response formats. JSON names a data representation, while WebSocket supplies a persistent bidirectional message channel rather than the stated repeated HTTP request/response pattern. A RESTful API describes the server interface organization, not the browser update technique. A correct AJAX names the asynchronous HTTP request-and-partial-update technique described. B incorrect JSON can encode a response but does not perform browser requests or update the page. C incorrect WebSocket uses a persistent bidirectional channel; that is not the specified HTTP request/response technique. D incorrect A RESTful API can serve the requests, but names an interface style rather than the client’s request-and-update technique.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 192 · AM0082
records.text: AM0082 Question 192 WEB28 Which techniques store data locally in a user’s browser? Select all that apply. Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A Cookies B Local storage C Session storage D IndexedDB Cookies; Local storage; Session storage; IndexedDB All four entries are browser storage techniques, although their persistence, data model and automatic transmission behavior differ. Cookies hold browser name/value data that can accompany matching requests. localStorage persists origin-specific strings, sessionStorage is scoped to a page session or tab, and IndexedDB supports structured local data. The revised question asks for every local-storage technique rather than assuming that only the API named local storage qualifies. A correct Cookies are browser-held name/value data, even though matching requests can transmit them. B correct localStorage persists origin-specific string values until removed or cleared. C correct sessionStorage stores browser data within a page-session or tab scope. D correct IndexedDB supplies structured local browser storage.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 193 · AM0083
records.text: AM0083 Question 193 WEB39 Which source-processing step removes unnecessary characters from CSS or JavaScript, distinct from bundling files together or compressing transfer encoding? Distinguish the purpose of each development or performance technique from its possible side effects. A Compression B Caching C Minification D Encryption Minification Minification removes unnecessary source characters, such as dispensable formatting, while preserving the intended program or stylesheet behavior. Bundling combines files and compression changes transfer encoding; these are separate operations even when a build pipeline performs them together. Caching instead reuses an existing representation, and encryption serves confidentiality. Restricting the question to source-character reduction makes minification the supported technique without claiming it also performs file combination. A incorrect Compression changes transfer encoding rather than performing the specified source-character reduction. B incorrect Caching reuses a representation rather than rewriting its source characters. C correct Minification is the source-character reduction step. D incorrect Encryption protects confidentiality rather than simplifying source formatting.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 194 · AM0084
records.text: AM0084 Question 194 WEB21 WEB14 Which client-side technique is used to handle and process user interactions, such as mouse clicks or keyboard inputs? Separate event dispatch, handler registration and cancellation of the browser default action. A Event handling B Form validation C Responsive design D Browser compatibility Event handling Events signal user actions and handlers run functions in response, including click events (p.53). A names this mechanism. Validation is a particular task, and responsive design/browser compatibility do not name action dispatch. Evidence: PDF p. 53. A correct Exact handler mechanism. B incorrect Checks fields rather than the general interaction mechanism. C incorrect Adapts layout rather than dispatching user actions. D incorrect Cross-browser support is not the event dispatch mechanism.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 195 · AM0085
records.text: AM0085 Question 195 WEB14 Which client-side technique is used to ensure that a web page displays correctly across different devices and screen sizes? Identify the requested presentation effect and layout context before matching the property or rule. A Event handling B Form validation C Responsive design D Browser compatibility Responsive design Responsive websites support desktop/tablet/phone screen sizes in the Bootstrap chapter. That fits devices and screen sizes; browser compatibility is a related but different browser-engine concern. Evidence: PDF p. 91. A incorrect Handles actions rather than screen size. B incorrect Checks input rather than screen size. C correct Exact screen adaptation concept. D incorrect Different browsers are a separate axis from device dimensions.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 196 · AM0086
records.text: AM0086 Question 196 WEB34 WEB35 WEB05 Which browser technique sends an asynchronous HTTP request, then processes a JSON response through a callback or promise without reloading the whole page? Choose the technique, rather than a resource-interface style or a persistent messaging protocol. Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. records.title: Web Programming — Question 221 · AM0111
records.text: AM0111 Question 221 WEB01 Which description defines client-server roles without requiring a particular physical-machine arrangement? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A Client and server must be the same physical machine B A client requests resources or services and a server receives requests and returns responses; they may share a machine C Any two different browser instances automatically form client and server roles D Any two pages on a website automatically form client and server roles A client requests resources or services and a server receives requests and returns responses; they may share a machine Client and server describe interacting roles: the client requests a resource or service and the server handles the request and returns a response. These roles can run on separate machines or on the same machine. Physical location therefore does not define the relationship. Two browser instances or two web pages also do not automatically establish a request-serving role pair. The corrected definition focuses on behavior while retaining the deployment distinction as a distractor. A incorrect The roles can share a machine, but sameness is not required. The scenario therefore identifies HTTP without depending on an unstated assumption about which networking layer is being tested. A correct HTTP defines GET requests, response status codes and resource representations. B incorrect FTP does not define the stated web GET/status exchange. C incorrect TCP/IP can carry the exchange but does not define its application-level GET or status semantics. D incorrect SMTP is a mail-transfer application protocol, not the stated web request/response semantics.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 223 · AM0113
records.text: AM0113 Question 223 WEB04 Which method in HTTP is used to retrieve a resource from a server? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. A GET B POST C PUT D DELETE GET WEB04 defines GET as retrieving a representation with safe semantics. That is the retrieval operation requested. POST asks a target to process supplied content, PUT creates or replaces the identified representation, and DELETE requests removal. These are intended method semantics; a badly designed server does not change which method the standard retrieval role belongs to. A correct GET is the HTTP method whose intended semantics retrieve a resource representation. B incorrect POST requests processing of supplied content rather than naming the standard safe retrieval operation. C incorrect PUT creates or replaces an identified representation instead of simply retrieving it. D incorrect DELETE requests removal of a resource association rather than reading its representation.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 224 · AM0114
records.text: AM0114 Question 224 WEB04 Which method in HTTP is used to send data to a server for processing? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. GET retrieves safely, PUT creates or replaces an identified representation, and DELETE removes an association. Those methods can carry protocol details, but the generic processing semantics in the stem are POST’s specific definition. A incorrect GET’s intended semantics retrieve a representation rather than request arbitrary content processing. B correct POST asks the target resource to process the supplied content. C incorrect PUT specifies creating or replacing the identified representation rather than the generic processing role. records.title: Web Programming — Question 226 · AM0116
records.text: AM0116 Question 226 WEB04 WEB-S10 Which HTTP status code indicates that the requested resource is not found on the server? A incorrect 200 reports success rather than the missing-resource condition in the stem. B incorrect 300 is a redirection-class code, not the note’s not-found status. C incorrect 400 concerns a malformed request rather than the unavailable resource identified here. D correct 404 is explicitly mapped to unavailable or not found in WEB04.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 227 · AM0117
records.text: AM0117 Question 227 WEB36 Which situations demonstrate concurrency when their requests make overlapping progress? Here simultaneously means overlapping progress, not necessarily execution at the same instant. Select all that apply. Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A The ability of the server to handle multiple clients simultaneously B The ability of the client to handle multiple servers simultaneously C The ability of the server to handle multiple requests from a single client D The ability of the client to handle multiple requests to a single server The ability of the server to handle multiple clients simultaneously; The ability of the client to handle multiple servers simultaneously; The ability of the server to handle multiple requests from a single client; The ability of the client to handle multiple requests to a single server Concurrency means overlapping progress, whereas parallelism requires execution at the same instant. A server can overlap work for several clients or several requests from one client. A client can likewise overlap interactions with several servers or multiple requests to one server. The question explicitly supplies overlap for each situation, making every listed arrangement an example of concurrency without asserting that all work physically runs in parallel. A correct Overlapping server work for several clients is concurrent. B correct Overlapping client interactions with several servers are concurrent. C correct Several overlapping requests from one client can create server concurrency. D correct A client can overlap multiple requests to the same server.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 228 · AM0118
records.text: AM0118 Question 228 WEB37 What is a race condition in the context of concurrency? Identify the shared-state invariant and the operations that must be coordinated. A A condition where two or more clients compete to establish a connection with the server B A condition where two or more servers compete to respond to a client request C A condition where multiple threads or processes access shared resources in an unpredictable manner D A condition where multiple clients send duplicate requests to the server Shared-resource correctness depends on execution interleaving. WEB37 describes two requests reading stock one, both accepting a sale, and both writing zero. The final correctness depends on their interleaving, which is the race-condition mechanism captured most closely by C’s unpredictable shared-resource access. Competing connections, multiple responders, or duplicate requests are not themselves sufficient; they become races only when shared-state correctness depends on timing. A incorrect Competition to establish a connection is not by itself a shared-state correctness failure caused by interleaving. B incorrect Several servers responding does not alone establish a race on shared mutable state. C correct This is the closest option: shared-state access can make correctness depend on the execution interleaving. D incorrect Duplicate requests can cause other problems, but duplication alone is not the defining race-condition mechanism.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 229 · AM0119
records.text: AM0119 Question 229 WEB37 Which technique directly protects one shared-state critical section with an exclusive lock that does not rely on busy waiting? Choose the exclusive-lock primitive, rather than a bounded-access counter or a messaging design. Identify the shared-state invariant and the operations that must be coordinated. A Mutex locks B Spinlocks C Semaphores D Message queues Mutex locks A mutex directly protects a critical section by allowing only one holder at a time. The question distinguishes that exclusive-lock abstraction from spinlock busy waiting, semaphore bounded-access counting and message-queue designs. A semaphore can also enforce exclusion when configured suitably, but it is not the specific exclusive-lock primitive requested. Choosing a primitive does not by itself guarantee application correctness: every conflicting update must use the protected critical section. A correct A mutex is the requested exclusive-lock primitive. B incorrect A spinlock relies on busy waiting, which the stem excludes. C incorrect A semaphore is the bounded-access counter abstraction excluded by the requested category. D incorrect A message queue is a messaging design rather than the requested lock primitive.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 230 · AM0120
records.text: AM0120 Question 230 WEB34 In an asynchronous browser request, what is the response callback’s role? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A A function invoked by the browser runtime or API when the response becomes available B A function that is called by the client to request a specific operation from the server C A function that is called by the server to handle concurrent client requests D A function that is called by the client to synchronize with the server A function invoked by the browser runtime or API when the response becomes available The callback is registered for later invocation by the browser runtime or API when the response becomes available. The remote server sends response data; it does not directly execute the browser function. A function that starts a request or a server request-handler function has a different role in the described interaction. The answer states both the owning execution environment and the event that causes invocation. A correct This states who invokes the browser response callback and when. B incorrect Starting a request is not the response callback’s role. C incorrect A server request handler is a different callback in a different environment. D incorrect A callback need not perform client/server synchronization.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 231 · AM0121
records.text: AM0121 Question 231 WEB35 WEB-S14 Which application-level protocol provides a persistent bidirectional message channel after its handshake? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A HTTP B FTP C TCP/IP D WebSocket WebSocket WebSocket establishes a persistent bidirectional channel on which either endpoint can exchange messages after the handshake. HTTP requests can also be issued asynchronously, but asynchronous programming alone does not supply this specific channel model. FTP has a different transfer role, and TCP/IP names lower-level networking foundations rather than the requested application protocol. The revised interaction requirement therefore distinguishes WebSocket without claiming it is the only way to avoid blocking a client. A incorrect Asynchronous HTTP requests do not by themselves define this persistent bidirectional message channel. B incorrect FTP is not the specified WebSocket-style application messaging protocol. C incorrect TCP/IP refers to lower-level networking rather than this application-level channel protocol. D correct WebSocket supplies the described persistent bidirectional channel.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 232 · AM0122
records.text: AM0122 Question 232 WEB35 What is long polling in client-server communication? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A A technique where the server continuously sends updates to the client B A technique where the client continuously sends requests to the server for updates C A technique where the server holds a request from the client until new data is available D A technique where the client holds a request from the server until new data is available The server holds a client request until data is available or timeout occurs. WEB35 defines long polling as holding a client request until an event or timeout, returning a response, and then reconnecting from the client. C captures that defining held-request step. It is not continuous unsolicited streaming on a finished response, repeated short polling without a held request, or a reversed arrangement in which a client holds a server-originated request. A incorrect Continuous unsolicited server updates describe streaming-like behavior rather than the held-request long-polling cycle. B incorrect Repeated immediate polling requests describe short polling rather than holding each request until an event or timeout. C correct Holding the client’s request until new data or timeout is the defining long-polling behavior. D incorrect This reverses the roles; the server holds a request initiated by the client.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 234 · AM0125
records.text: AM0125 Question 234 WEB05 WEB-S14 Which protocol is commonly used for secure communication between a client and server? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. A HTTP B FTP C TCP/IP D HTTPS HTTPS WEB05 defines HTTPS as HTTP over TLS with channel confidentiality, integrity, and certificate-based server authentication. It is the offered protocol for a protected web client/server exchange. Plain HTTP and the TCP/IP networking family do not supply those protections by themselves, and FTP is not the secure HTTP protocol being described. These protections do not replace application validation or authorization. A incorrect Plain HTTP lacks the TLS protections that distinguish secure web communication in WEB05. B incorrect FTP is not the HTTPS protocol identified for TLS-protected web exchanges. C incorrect TCP/IP supplies underlying networking rather than the specific protected HTTP channel requested. D correct HTTPS adds TLS confidentiality, integrity, and checked server identity to HTTP communication.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 235 · AM0126
records.text: AM0126 Question 235 WEB36 What is a load balancer in the context of client-server systems? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A A device that balances the load between multiple clients B A device that balances the load between multiple servers C A device that balances the load between the client and server D A device that balances the load between different network protocols Distribute work across multiple server instances. WEB36 says workers or processes and a load balancer distribute work across server instances. That directly supports B. The balancing target is the pool of servers handling incoming work, rather than clients, the two communication roles, or protocol types. The note also warns that distributing requests does not automatically coordinate shared data or session state. A incorrect The described load-balancing role distributes server work rather than balancing computational load among clients. B correct A load balancer distributes incoming work across multiple server instances. C incorrect It does not divide one application’s work equally between the abstract client and server roles. D incorrect Balancing among network protocol types is not the server-instance distribution role defined in WEB36.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 236 · AM0127
records.text: AM0127 Question 236 WEB28 WEB29 Which browser-stored mechanism normally carries an opaque session identifier automatically on matching requests, without adding that token to each URL? Follow the identifier and server-side state through the stated lifecycle or access check; distinguish client-controlled claims from server decisions. A Cookies B HTML forms C URL parameters D Server-side caching Cookies A cookie stores browser-side name/value data and is automatically attached to requests that match its scope and security rules. It can carry the opaque identifier used to find server-side session state. Forms or URL parameters can explicitly transmit identifiers, but do not provide the automatic matching-request behavior specified. Server-side caching stores server data rather than supplying this browser identifier carrier. A correct A matching cookie is automatically attached to requests and can carry the opaque session identifier. B incorrect A form submits explicit values when submitted, rather than automatically attaching stored data to all matching requests. C incorrect A URL parameter must be included in a URL; the scenario explicitly keeps the token out of URLs. D incorrect Server caching concerns retained server-side data, not the browser mechanism that automatically carries the identifier.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 237 · AM0128
records.text: AM0128 Question 237 WEB34 What is AJAX in web programming? Identify the execution side and communication pattern, keeping runtime, transport, data format and callback roles distinct. A A programming language for server-side scripting B A database management system C A technique for asynchronous client-server communication D A web server software A technique for asynchronous client-server communication AJAX is a web-development technique with asynchronous server communication and page updates without refresh. It combines technologies instead of being a server language, database system or server software. Evidence: PDF p. 89. A incorrect Not the module classification. B incorrect Not the module classification. C correct Exact asynchronous communication technique. D incorrect Not the module classification.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 238 · AM0129
records.text: AM0129 Question 238 WEB05 What is a RESTful API? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. A An API that supports real-time communication between client and server B An API that uses the REST architectural style for client-server communication C An API that only supports server-to-server communication D An API that is used for database management An API following the REST architectural style. WEB05 describes REST through client/server separation, stateless requests, cacheability, and a uniform resource interface. B is the definition matching those architectural constraints. Real-time delivery is not required, server-to-server-only use is not a REST limitation, and database management is only a possible implementation domain. Returning JSON alone also does not establish REST. A incorrect Real-time communication is not the defining constraint or requirement of a RESTful API. B correct Following REST architectural constraints is what makes an API RESTful. C incorrect REST is not restricted to server-to-server communication; browsers can access resource interfaces too. D incorrect Database management is one possible domain, not the architectural definition of REST.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 239 · AM0130
records.text: AM0130 Question 239 WEB39 What is server-side caching in client-server systems? Distinguish the purpose of each development or performance technique from its possible side effects. A A technique to store client-side data on the server B A technique to store server-side data on the client C A technique to store frequently accessed server-side data in memory for faster retrieval D A technique to store client and server data in a separate cache server Retain frequently accessed server-side results for faster reuse. WEB39 describes caching as reusing a representation or result and explicitly gives server caching of rendered pages or expensive query results. C matches that faster-retrieval purpose. The cache need not be a separate server, and merely transferring client data to a server or server data to a client is not the defining reuse mechanism. Validity, privacy, and cache keys still matter. A incorrect Storing client-originated data on a server does not by itself establish result reuse or caching. B incorrect Placing server data on a client describes client-side storage rather than server-side caching. C correct Retaining frequently reused server-side results avoids repeated work and accelerates later retrieval. D incorrect A separate cache server is optional; the defining property is reusable results, not a mandatory deployment topology.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 240 · CS0032
records.text: CS0032 Question 240 WEB04 WEB09 Which form METHOD value normally places submitted name/value pairs in the request body rather than the URL query? Separate the control role, displayed content, submitted value and form destination. A GET B INPUT C ACTION D POST POST For ordinary HTML forms, GET usually puts successful name/value pairs in the URL query, while POST places form data in the request body. METHOD does not specify an element-at-a-time parser; parsing depends on encoding and the receiving implementation. INPUT is a control element name and ACTION is a form attribute, so neither is a method value. The corrected question tests the supported form-submission distinction rather than the unsupported parsing premise. A incorrect GET normally places the pairs in the URL query. B incorrect INPUT names a control element rather than a METHOD value. C incorrect ACTION identifies a separate form attribute rather than a METHOD value. D correct POST normally puts submitted form data in the request body.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 241 · CS0033
records.text: CS0033 Question 241 WEB02 WEB06 Which claim is false about HTML as an open-standard text markup format? Use the element or attribute meaning and document structure, rather than appearance or a similar-looking name. A It supports interoperability, though feature support varies across platforms and browsers B Its text can be transmitted over a network as a web representation C Its source represents document structure using text markup rather than requiring a fixed small file size D Because it is proprietary technology Because it is proprietary technology HTML supplies document structure in a text markup representation within the open Web standards setting. That supports interoperability but does not guarantee identical feature support in every browser, a tiny document size or a fixed transfer speed. The alternatives remove those universal promises. Calling HTML proprietary contradicts the stated open-standard setting, while the other choices now make qualified claims about its representation and delivery. A incorrect Qualified interoperability is consistent with differing feature support. B incorrect A web representation can transmit HTML text without promising a fixed speed. C incorrect Text markup expresses structure without guaranteeing a small size. D correct The proprietary characterization conflicts with the open-standard setting.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 242 · CS0034
records.text: CS0034 Question 242 WEB19 WEB-S13 What is the output of the following JavaScript fragment? for (n = 1; n < 7; n++) { if (n % 5 == 0) { document.write(n + " is multiple of 5"); } } Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A 5 is multiple of 5 B 1 2 3 4 5 is multiple of 5 6 C 5 is multiple of 5 6 7 D 1 2 3 4 5 6 5 is multiple of 5 The loop starts at 1 and visits integers 1 through 6 because n<7 excludes 7. The p.49 arithmetic table shows % as remainder, including 8%3=2. Among these values only 5 has remainder zero on division by 5, so the conditional writes once: 5 is multiple of 5. This uses the conventional n++ loop step; the module shows for begin/condition/step but does not separately define postfix value semantics, which are immaterial because the step value is discarded. Evidence: PDF p. 49, PDF p. 49, PDF p. 50, PDF p. 47. A correct Exactly the single matching value 5. B incorrect Prints values outside the if branch; no unconditional write exists. C incorrect Adds 6 and 7 even though 6 fails and 7 is excluded. D incorrect Ignores the conditional and omits the literal message.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 243 · CS0035
records.text: CS0035 Question 243 WEB22 WEB16 In an ordinary browser page, which statements about document.write("Hello World") are true? Classify properties and values inclusively: a method is also a function-valued property. Select all that apply. Track the value and type at each operation, applying the stated conversion, indexing or mathematical rule. A write is a property B write is a method C document is a property D write is an object write is a property; write is a method; document is a property; write is an object document.write is a method and also a function-valued property of document. In a normal browser page, document is exposed as a property of window. Functions are objects in JavaScript, so the write function value is also an object. These descriptions are compatible views of the same expression rather than mutually exclusive categories. All four statements are therefore true under the explicit inclusive-classification convention. A correct write is a function-valued property of document. B correct Calling that function through document is a method invocation. C correct document is the browsing context’s document property. D correct The write function value is an object because JavaScript functions are objects.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 244 · NS0284
records.text: NS0284 Question 244 WEB08 Consider nav ul { list-style-type: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } What problem does this solve when creating a navigation bar? Use the element or attribute meaning and document structure, rather than appearance or a similar-looking name. A Removes bullet points and default spacing, allowing custom layout B Aligns the navbar to the right of the page C Adds hover effects to list items D Converts the list into a dropdown menu Remove list bullets and default margin/padding. This rule resets navigation-list styling. list-style-type:none removes markers, and zero margin/padding removes default list spacing. None of those declarations specifies alignment, hover styling, or dropdown behavior. Thus A describes the actual effect, leaving layout and interaction to additional rules. A correct These declarations remove markers and default spacing so later layout rules can start from a clean list. B incorrect No text alignment, flex justification, or positioning rule aligns the navbar right. C incorrect No :hover selector or hover-specific declaration is present. D incorrect A dropdown needs additional layout and interaction rules, not just this reset.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 245 · NS0311
records.text: NS0311 Question 245 WEB27 Which PHP superglobal is dedicated to URL query parameters, excluding configurable combined-source arrays? Identify the data source or security responsibility precisely, and check whether a combined source or a different control could also qualify. A $_REQUEST B $_POST C $_GET D isset() $_GET $_GET is the dedicated query-parameter source. $_REQUEST can also contain GET values depending on configuration, but it is a combined-source array and is explicitly excluded by this question. $_POST represents supported form POST data, while isset tests existence and non-null rather than acting as an input-data container. Removing placeholder brackets makes the array names clear without inventing a particular field name or request value. A incorrect This combines configured request sources rather than being dedicated to query parameters. B incorrect This is the supported form POST source. C correct This is the dedicated URL-query source. D incorrect This tests whether a variable or entry exists and is non-null.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 246 · NS0332
records.text: NS0332 Question 246 WEB02 ____________is a service that allows organizations and individuals to post a website or a web page onto the Internet. Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. A Web hosting B Internet service provider C Web client D Domain name registration Web hosting WEB02 defines hosting as supplying the environment where a website is served. This is the service enabling an organization’s site or page to be made available online. An ISP supplies connectivity, domain registration reserves a name, and a web client requests resources. Those supporting roles are not the hosting service described. A correct Hosting supplies an environment in which the site is served to users. B incorrect An ISP provides connectivity rather than necessarily the environment serving the website. C incorrect A web client requests resources instead of providing the publishing environment. D incorrect Domain registration reserves a name rather than serving the site’s content.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 247 · NS0340
records.text: NS0340 Question 247 WEB01 WEB03 WEB-S14 Which protocol is mostly used for communication between client and server in a web application? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. A FTP B SMTP C HTTP D SSH HTTP WEB01 describes the Web as a resource system commonly using HTTP, and WEB03 details its request/response exchange. HTTPS adds TLS protection to HTTP but does not make one of the other offered protocols the ordinary web exchange. Among these choices, HTTP is the application protocol used to request and return web resources. A incorrect FTP is not the HTTP request/response web protocol described in the note. B incorrect SMTP is not the webpage request/response protocol developed in WEB03. C correct HTTP carries the web resource requests and responses described in the complete note. D incorrect SSH is not the ordinary webpage request/response protocol identified here.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 248 · NS0342
records.text: NS0342 Question 248 WEB15 What is the extension of JavaScript file? Check exact language syntax, declaration rules and execution context before reasoning about the result. A .javaS B .JS C .java D CSS .js is the conventional JavaScript source extension. WEB15 uses an external app.js script and explicitly calls it a .js file. B identifies that extension family despite its uppercase printed letters. Actual filename case must match the deployed resource where paths are case-sensitive; the conventional spelling is lowercase .js. The other choices name different or invented file extensions rather than JavaScript source. A incorrect The invented .javaS suffix is not the conventional .js extension specified by WEB15. B correct This identifies the JS extension; use conventional lowercase .js and preserve actual filename case in paths. C incorrect .java is not the .js source-file extension used for JavaScript in the note. D incorrect CSS identifies stylesheet source rather than the JavaScript file extension.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 249 · NS0355
records.text: NS0355 Question 249 WEB29 A web application has two protected endpoints. The profile endpoint checks a valid session identifier and its server-side user record on every request. The transfer endpoint grants access whenever the editable logged_in cookie equals 1 and ignores session validation. An unauthenticated attacker has no valid session and sets logged_in=1. Which result follows from these access checks? Follow the identifier and server-side state through the stated lifecycle or access check; distinguish client-controlled claims from server decisions. A The cookie edit can bypass the transfer endpoint, but does not grant access to the profile endpoint B The cookie edit grants access to both endpoints because both receive the same cookie C Neither endpoint can be bypassed unless the attacker first obtains a genuine session identifier D HTTPS alone prevents either endpoint from accepting a forged logged_in value The cookie edit can bypass the transfer endpoint, but does not grant access to the profile endpoint The two endpoints use different trust paths. The transfer endpoint trusts an attacker-controlled flag, so the forged value satisfies its stated access check without a valid session. The profile endpoint requires authenticated server-side state, which the attacker lacks, so the unrelated cookie does not grant access there. HTTPS protects transport rather than validating the truth of a client-generated login claim. The bypass therefore affects the transfer endpoint only. A correct Only the transfer endpoint relies solely on the forgeable flag; the profile endpoint still requires a valid session. B incorrect Receiving the same cookie does not make the endpoints apply the same authorization rule. C incorrect The transfer check requires no genuine session identifier, so stealing one is unnecessary for that bypass. D incorrect HTTPS does not prevent a client from submitting a false authorization flag.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 250 · NS0360
records.text: NS0360 Question 250 WEB09 WEB07 Why should form <input> elements include an associated <label> with the for attribute? Separate the control role, displayed content, submitted value and form destination. A It enables offline form storage B It encrypts user data C It increases form submission speed D It improves accessibility: screen readers announce the label when the input is focused Provide an accessible label associated with the input. WEB09 links a label’s for to the control id, and WEB07 requires programmatic control labels. That association lets assistive technology identify the input and announce its label. It does not alter storage, encryption, or network submission speed. D states the accessibility purpose directly, rather than confusing it with unrelated browser or transport features. A incorrect Label association does not create offline storage for form values. B incorrect Labels do not encrypt data or replace HTTPS transport protection. C incorrect Associating a label does not accelerate form submission over the network. D correct The programmatic label identifies the focused input for screen readers and other assistive technology.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 251 · NS0795
records.text: NS0795 Question 251 WEB04 WEB40 What is the difference between GET and POST methods? When would you use each? Identify the protocol layer and the intended request, response or channel semantics. GET retrieves safely and usually places form values in the query; POST asks the target to process body content. WEB04 recommends GET for reading representations rather than intentional state changes. POST suits submitted processing or actions such as enrollment with proper authorization and CSRF controls. Neither method encrypts data; use HTTPS for channel protection. POST body values remain visible to tools and subject to configured size limits rather than becoming secret or unlimited.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 252 · NS0796
records.text: NS0796 Question 252 WEB27 WEB21 Why is client-side validation alone not enough for security? Separate event dispatch, handler registration and cancellation of the browser default action. Clients can bypass or alter browser checks, so the server must validate and authorize again. WEB27 requires server checks for required fields, type, length, and range, plus authentication and authorization before processing. Browser validation improves feedback but arbitrary clients can submit different requests. Bind SQL values and encode output for its context as well; encryption or merely connecting to a database does not replace these application controls.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 253 · NS0797
records.text: NS0797 Question 253 WEB20 What is the DOM and why is it important for web development? Track which node is selected or created, and distinguish changing content from attaching a node. The DOM is the document’s node hierarchy, enabling scripts to inspect and update page content and behavior. WEB20 selects nodes, creates elements, and attaches them to that hierarchy. Creating a node does not itself insert it, and missing lookups must be guarded. textContent safely inserts untrusted plain text, whereas innerHTML reparses markup and can replace descendant state. The DOM connects document structure to interactive browser updates.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 254 · NS0798
records.text: NS0798 Question 254 WEB28 WEB29 A user closes their browser and reopens it. They are still logged in. How is this possible? Follow the identifier and server-side state through the stated lifecycle or access check; distinguish client-controlled claims from server decisions. A persistent remember/session token or browser restoration can preserve the login flow. WEB28 says reopening while logged in may use persistent session or remember tokens or browser restoration. The browser can retain an identifier, but the server still has to accept and validate it against its authorization state. Local persistence alone is not proof of authenticated access, and the observation does not identify one unique storage mechanism.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 255 · NS0799
records.text: NS0799 Question 255 WEB28 Why would a developer choose local storage over cookies? Identify the role requested and compare it with the definitions and constraints in the cited passages. localStorage persists origin data without automatically attaching it to every matching request. WEB28 contrasts localStorage’s persistent strings with cookies’ automatic request transmission. It can avoid transmitting data needed only by the client. JavaScript can still send stored tokens explicitly, so localStorage is not inherently incapable of session designs. Script-access risks and persistence policies must be considered; neither mechanism is universally preferable for sensitive authentication data.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 256 · NS0800
records.text: NS0800 Question 256 WEB06 What does HTML stand for? Use the element or attribute meaning and document structure, rather than appearance or a similar-looking name. A Hyper Text Markup Language B High Tech Modern Language C Hyper Transfer Markup Language D Home Tool Markup Language HyperText Markup Language WEB06 directly expands HTML as HyperText Markup Language. The name identifies markup used for document structure and meaning rather than a general programming or transfer protocol. The other phrases substitute different words and are not the expansion in the note. This vocabulary answer does not depend on a browser version or an implementation choice. A correct Hyper Text Markup Language matches the note’s expansion, with only spacing variation in HyperText. B incorrect High Tech Modern Language is not the expansion given in WEB06. C incorrect Transfer replaces the required word Text and gives the wrong expansion. D incorrect Home Tool Markup Language is not the HTML expansion in the note.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 257 · NS0801
records.text: NS0801 Question 257 WEB07 WEB11 Which HTML tag creates a hyperlink? Identify which elements a rule targets and distinguish selector syntax from declaration syntax. A B C D with an href destination. WEB07 gives Read as the link pattern. The anchor element creates the user-facing hyperlink; href is its destination attribute, not a standalone tag. link is used for relationships such as external stylesheets, and url is not the anchor element. Thus C names the correct element among the supplied choices. A incorrect link is used for resource relationships such as external stylesheets rather than the shown user-facing anchor. B incorrect href is an attribute on an anchor, not the hyperlink element itself. C correct The anchor element with href creates the hyperlink described in WEB07. D incorrect url is not the supported HTML anchor tag.

records.title: Web Programming — Question 258 · NS0802
